pages.text: In 1951 Boris Belousov found a mixture that turned from yellow to clear and back, again and again. Nobody believed him. The $(thing)Brusselator$() shows how: one species makes more of itself from another and is used up again, and past a threshold $(thing)B > 1 + A²$() the steady mixture can no longer stay still.

The $(item)Oscillator Vessel$() makes $(item)Chemical Clocks$() from redstone and sulfuric acid. Set the feeds so that B is at least 0.2 past the threshold and the beat (about 2π/A seconds) falls between 3 and 8 seconds.
